description: Check whether plans cover specific medications (by RxCUI) and have specific doctors in network (by NPI). Use search_drugs and search_doctors first to get the ids. Each result has a `status`: covered, not_covered, generic_covered (the generic version is covered; confirm the brand with the insurer) or unknown. unknown means the plan gave CMS no coverage data for that item. It does NOT mean not covered: tell the person to confirm with the insurer.
name: check_coverage
title: Check doctors and drugs
